messages.author: 391721664553df57
messages.subject: blavaan and MplusAutomation
parts:
Hi all,

We are running a Bayesian Path Analysis with a binary outcome for a dataset with more than 1 million rows. We were not able to fit our model using blavaan package, but we were able to do it using Mplus. However, we would like to use blavPredict() function.

 

Do you know whether it is possible to use the results from models fitted in MPlus and read them as objects in blavaan package after having used the MplusAutomation package that allows us to read, run and extract model summaries from analyses performed using Mplus?


When trying to make use of the blavPredict(), we got the following error message:

 

> ypred <- blavPredict(test, type = "ypred")

Error in blavPredict(test, type = "ypred") :

  inherits(object, "blavaan") is not TRUE

 

Best regards,

 

             Leila

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan and MplusAutomation
parts:
The error is saying that the object is not result from blavaan, so it doesnt work.

I dont think there is a good way to make it work. You would have to recode the results from mplus to provide all the objects and information needed from blavaa. I also dont think you can export everything you would need from mplus
